subject: Figurative constant values
notes: kb/Work PB1415 (wave 1021 B). SR1 a)'s ALL half is now asked in the VALUE clause too: FigurativeConstants.Classify carries BeginsWithAll (it used to strip the optional ALL of Formats 1-5, so VALUE ALL ZEROS on a numeric item read as ZERO), and DataBinder.ValidateValueCategory (item VALUE, level-88 VALUE, group funnel) and ExpressionBinder's arithmetic-operand arm both ask the ONE gate FigurativeAssociation.GateAllZeroAsNumeric (construct figurative-all-zero-numeric-removed-2002, COBOL0902). DETERMINATION, a DERIVED edition edge (VCR Table 7 row 7.28): accepted at 85, where ALL before a figurative word is redundant and CCVS-85 writes VALUE ALL ZEROS on PIC 999 (NC201A/NC211A/NC250A), refused at 2002+ (Annex E lists no 2014->2023 change, so 2014 agrees; the edge is 2002, the sibling SR3's edge, row 7.13). The procedure arm (PB218) moved from 0844 at every edition to the same gate. SR1 b) is each prohibiting rule's own site. Editions: 85 (accepted, ALL redundant), 2002-2023 (ALL ZERO refused). kb/Work PB1544 (wave 1039 A): the main sentence ('A figurative constant may be used whenever literal appears in a format') for the user-defined figurative constant, the symbolic-character (8.3.2.2.29; 12.3.7.4 GR11 a)), and its twin the constant-name (13.10.4 GR1): both are resolved by the ONE ExpressionBinder.LiteralAliasOf, so CALL Format 2's keyword-less, BY CONTENT and BY VALUE literal-2 and INVOKE's literal-2 admit them (they drew COBOL1639 / COBOL0844) and SR1 a) at BY VALUE (14.9.4.3 SR23, 14.9.23.3 SR16) refuses a symbolic-character by name (COBOL1762 / COBOL0828). Witnessed by the golden 2002/pb1544_literal_alias_arguments (figurative fill [AAA] at a PIC X(3) formal per 8.3.3.6.4 GR2/GR10) and the pb1544-* negatives. retired-witness: unit:LiteralAliasResolutionDriftTests (malformed form (unit:<Class>.<Method> is required); re-cited with its method by the train 1039b lander) retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.cs#RewrittenAllZeroRawText (the method is deleted (kb/Work PB3962): the rewriter no longer marks a ZERO arithmetic before a signed literal, so an ALL ZERO -5 VALUE list parses as the figurative constant and needs no reader-side patch)
